300 rescued cats and dogs. One small team in Sabah.

ALIR is an independent, non-profit, no-kill shelter. Since 2009 we’ve taken in the animals nobody else would: the injured, the abandoned, the blind and the paralysed. We pay their vet bills and care for them until they find a home.

It started with a blind puppy on a roadside

“Saving one animal won’t change the world. But it changes the whole world for that one animal.”

In 2009 our founders found a puppy by the road in Kota Belud. They named her Chuggy, and the vet told them she had been born blind.

After Chuggy, they kept saying yes: to sick street dogs, to old pets whose owners wanted them put down, to disabled animals, and to dogs other people had given up on. That’s still how ALIR works today.

How you can help

We get no government funding. Every meal, every surgery and every rescue is paid for by people like you.

  • Pay a vet bill

    Give by bank transfer or PayPal. Surgery for a broken leg can cost RM3,000.

    Donate money

  • Send food

    Order rice or pet food on WhatsApp and our suppliers deliver it to the shelter.

    Order food

  • Adopt or foster

    Give a recovered animal a home, or look after one while it heals.

    Message us

  • Share a story

    One share can reach the person who saves the next animal.
